  -extra-vars value
    	a variable the run starts with, as key=value, key:=yaml or @file.yaml (repeatable); a runbook reads it as vars.<name>
  -skip-tags value
    	leave out the tasks carrying one of these tags, even ones --tags selects (comma-separated, repeatable)
  -tags value
    	run only the tasks carrying one of these tags (comma-separated, repeatable)
